chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad from Hariz from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"When a man plucks the hair from his two armpits after entering the state of Ihram, he is obliged to offer a Dam (sacrifice)."

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامِ: the state of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.دَمٌ: a sacrificial animal (Dam) offered as expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for plucking armpit hair while in Ihram?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this ruling from Imam al-Sadi’ (AS) to clarify the specific expiation (*kaffarah*) for plucking armpit hair during Ihram, distinguishing it from shaving. The requirement of a *Dam* (sacrificing a sheep or goat) underscores the principle that minor bodily grooming acts, when performed intentionally or by mistake while in the sacred state, incur a tangible sacrificial penalty to restore spiritual purity.
